description_blocks.text: Overview

Step into the race of Relic Rush, a fast-paced, family-friendly board game where interaction, constant motion, and real-time excitement collide. It’s a thrilling game across a board that changes as you play, filled with interactive dangers and delightful surprises.
We recommend checking the project instruction first to see if this is the proper game for you. Find all details on the MakerWorld.
This model is offered as a crowdfunding project. Your purchase involves two steps:
1. Purchase the necessary parts kit on this page to assemble your model.
2. Get the 3D print files by backing the project on the crowdfunding page.

*Relic Rush is continuously improved based on feedback from our players and makers. The Creator is actively refining models, mechanics, and components based on community feedback. For the latest updates, upgrade files, and additional content, be sure to follow the creator’s page on MakerWorld.
Fast and Furious
Everyone takes their turns at once on a board that’s never static. Roll the dice, and if you land on a disaster—trigger it instantly with the custom remote!
Strategy meets speed: plan your route, time your moves, and outpace the clock before time runs out and catastrophe strikes for all!
Traps Keep Everyone Guessing
The board itself is your opponent. Navigate a landscape where every element can change:
Bridge: a collapse could knock out any players on the bridge and block one of the paths to the relics.
Spikes: risking the spikes can provide a faster, but more dangerous path.
Stairs: one of the fastest paths to the relics can transform into a player-eliminating slide.
Wall: this rotating piece can open or block your path to the relics.
River & Lava: time your movement to not get trapped and swept over the edge. Or be risky and climb the vertical lava-fall.
Two Complete Build Versions
Choose the experience that fits your style:
CyberBrick Version: contains everything you need to build the game board with servo & motor-controlled interactive elements along with a remote. This is the default version of the game.

Wired Version: uses manually-operated traps without a remote control. This reduces the cost of components but still includes a motorized river and lava flow. To keep track of rounds, you can use this free timer app on your phone.
Custom Remote & Organized Storage
Build your custom remote and an optional storage container for the player figures, custom dice, relics and other game pieces.
Choose between printable and laser-cut versions of each.
The storage box stacks with the remote.
Includes extra space for future expansion components.
Made for Makers
Are you up for a challenge? Relic Rush is a great project for people who enjoy the process of building something complex.
360° of detailed design
200+ unique parts.
Final weight: 3.5kg+
Full step-by-step assembly guide (takes about 4 hours)
Print in multi-color or paint and detail it yourself.
The board is a versatile playspace—create and share your own game modes with the community.
Remote Control Instruction
Relic Rush Board Game is designed to work with the Remote Control. The creator has uploaded pre-configured settings for immediate play,
while the CyberBrick App allows full customization of controller functions to match your personal preferences.
